name: branding-quadrant-mosaic-logo-with-market-sign-and-tote
title: Chequered-block market logo with lit cube sign and coral tote
whatItIs: A white slide with a black symbol built from quarter circles and squares, a bold sans wordmark 'Martiva Mart' and a black '2024' tab. Two applications: a glowing cube sign on a red wall showing the mark in coral on cream, and a person holding a white tote with an enlarged coral mosaic and vertical name.
whatItMeans: Bold, systematic and friendly; modular shapes suggest stalls in a market.
techniques: Build a symbol from a grid of quarter-circle and square modules.
Enlarge and crop the symbol as a pattern on bags.
Use a limited coral on cream for applications.
Attach a small year tab to the wordmark.

vocabulary.definition: A mark built from repeatable geometric units.
A square with one rounded corner used as a shape unit.
An illuminated cube or panel with a logo.
A small block containing a date beside a logo.
